bug_info.bug_desc: When MSECCFG.MML is set and RLB is clear, the PMP configuration write-enable path does not check whether the proposed pmpcfg value creates an M-mode-only executable region or a locked executable shared region. The prohibited write is therefore accepted even though Smepmp requires it to leave pmpcfg unchanged.
bug_info.fix_hint: Derive a suppression predicate from MML, RLB, and the proposed PMP configuration, then include its negation in pmp_cfg_we so prohibited executable-region writes are ignored.
